exposure: Pulmonary surfactant (200 mg/kg) combined with budesonide suspension (0.25 mg/kg)
cohort: Very low birth weight infants were randomly assigned to either a control group receiving pulmonary surfactant or an intervention group receiving pulmonary surfactant and budesonide suspension.
finding: The combination of pulmonary surfactant with budesonide suspension significantly decreased the incidence of bronchopulmonary dysplasia, reduced the duration of invasive mechanical ventilation, and promoted earlier weaning from oxygen supplement in very low birth weight infants.
